description:
## Finding

20 functions in the workspace could be `const fn` per `clippy::missing_const_for_fn`. The MSRV is 1.73, which supports `const fn` for all the constructs flagged.

## Notable cases (by impact)

| Location | Function | Effect of const-ifying |
|---|---|---|
| pkix-path/src/lib.rs:409 | `TrustAnchor::new` | Allows trust anchors at compile time, e.g. for embedded test fixtures |
| pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1556 | `NcTypeMask::intersects` | Internal — small perf, mostly idiom |
| pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1576 | `name_type_bit` | Internal helper |
| pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:190 | `crl_reason_name` | Pure ASCII match — natural fit |
| pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:367 | `sc081_validity_cap` | Useful — callers may want it in const context |
| pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:329-350 | `LintResult::is_pass`, `is_finding`, `is_fatal`, `detail` | Useful — callers may want compile-time evaluation |
| pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:710,716,722 | `DeviationRunner::new`, `lint_runner`, `deviation_store` | Idiom |
| pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:520 | `effective_severity` | Internal |
| pkix-lint/src/report.rs:106 | `severity_of` | Internal |
| pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:121 | `validate_attribute_cert` (stub) | Stub — likely will need state once impl'd |
| pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:105 | `verify_scts` (stub) | Stub |

## Why it matters

`TrustAnchor::new` being const would let downstream crates declare:

```rust
const ROOT: TrustAnchor = TrustAnchor::new(...);
```

Useful for `no_std` embedded targets where trust anchors are baked into the firmware.

`LintResult::is_pass` etc. are `match`-on-enum predicates — the canonical "should be const fn" shape.

## Fix

Mechanical. Be careful about the stub ones (`validate_attribute_cert`, `verify_scts`) — they will likely need to be non-const once implemented, so adding `const` now would be a breaking change later. Skip those.

## Priority

P3 — public-API const-correctness for `TrustAnchor::new` and `LintResult::is_*` is genuinely useful. Internal ones are P4.
title: P3: 20 functions could be const fn; TrustAnchor::new and LintResult::is_* are notable wins
